name: send_mail
description: Send an email from your aimail address. Returns delivery status. To reply, pass the original message_id (the reply is threaded). To forward, pass the original message_id and start the subject with "Fw:".

to.description: Recipient address(es): a comma-separated string or an array.

subject.description: Subject line. On a reply keep the original subject and prefix "Re:"; on a forward prefix "Fw:".

cc.description: CC address(es): a comma-separated string or an array.

message_id.description: Original message_id to reply to (threads the reply) or to forward.

name: manage_contacts
description: Manage your contact whitelist: check if an address is allowed, add, remove, or update entries. `update` changes an existing entry's direction.

action.description: Action to perform (update = change direction of an existing entry).

direction.description: Whitelist direction (for update, the new direction).

name: contact_profile
description: Look up a contact's profile. Pass address (exact) or name (server-side search) — at least one is required.

name: set_contact_profile
description: Store or update a contact's profile.

name: email_summary
description: Read the stored summary of an email thread. Returns found:false when the message_id is unknown to the local mailbox (found:true with an empty summary = stored but empty).

name: set_email_summary
description: Save the summary of an email thread.

name: search_mail
description: Search YOUR OWN locally stored mail (offline, no network). Matches keywords in subject/body/attachment text; filter by mailbox (inbound/outbound/all), time window (since/until YYYY-MM-DD) and sender (from, substring). Use it to recall past conversations, find when an event happened, or recover attachment content.

query.description: Space-separated keywords (AND); empty = browse by filters

name: board_status
description: Get a board's working status: goal, progress per status with assignees, and blockers.

name: board_task_list
description: List a board's tasks, optionally filtered by status or assignee.

name: board_task_show
description: Show one task's full details, including parent-task context.

task_id.description: Task ID (t_<short>_<board8>, or the short_id from the task mail, e.g. T1)

name: board_heartbeat
description: Signal your task is still in progress (a ready task advances to running).

task_id.description: Task ID (t_<short>_<board8>, or the short_id from the task mail, e.g. T1)

name: board_members
description: List a board's members and their roles.

name: board_roles
description: List a board's role permissions (optionally one role's members and verbs).

name: aimail_address
description: Manage your own mailbox: bind it, pause it, resume it, or unbind it. bind: activate with your one-time code (shared_a-…). If you unbound this mailbox before, bind restores it with no code. An already-bound mailbox is returned as-is. pause: stop receiving locally; the cloud key stays active. resume: start receiving again. unbind: detach this mailbox from your agent — you stop receiving new mail for it; bind it again to restore. Self-service — no CLI needed.

email.description: The mailbox address this acts on

gateway_url.description: AIMail gateway URL (or set AIMAIL_GW_URL) — needed for a first-time cloud activation

name: role_calibrator
description: Reset your identity card based on your configuration and history.
